name: Croissy Open 2018
information: Competition is included in the exhibition "l'empire des jouets". Competitor limit is 100. Entrance is free. Public transportation is RER A "Chatou - Croissy" station, around 15'/ 1km by feet : RER A schedule : [https://www.transilien.com/en] The venue is a theatre room of 200 persons with bleacher and a stage. The exhibition "l'empire des jouets" is in the castle : [https://www.croissy.com/agenda/1156-l-empire-des-jouets-a-croissy.html]
